summary: WAYLOAM v0.2.3.alpha fixes missing UI icons with bundled vector assets and sharpens the route identity with a cleaner mark and solid destination point.
highlights: Navigation and in-app symbols now use bundled Compose vector icons instead of a downloadable icon font.
The WAYLOAM route mark has a cleaner W-shaped flow with a small origin and a solid destination point.
The launcher, Android themed icon, in-app mark and repository wordmark now share the same endpoint treatment.
changed: The home logo is smaller and more restrained so it behaves like a real app mark rather than a large header graphic.
The route mark now connects cleanly into the destination marker and uses stronger origin/destination hierarchy.
fixed: Fixed missing navigation and interface icons by replacing runtime font ligatures with bundled Material vector icons.
Fixed the campsite symbol fallback that previously caused an icon compile issue.
Fixed the hollow destination ring in the WAYLOAM logo; the destination marker is now filled.
